For your 2021 Subaru Outback in driveway in 94704 with outlet nearby, wanting inside + out + dog hair from one back-seat spot, with $400 all-in cap:

**Mapping:** "inside and out" = Full detail (The Schooner). Your one-spot shed = Pet hair removal add-on, NOT excessive. Subaru Outback = midsize / Class B.

**Saturday?** Yes, they work Saturdays — morning arrival window 8:00am-9:30am only — and Sat Nov 7 morning and Sat Nov 21 morning are currently open. But Saturday adds a $25 Saturday fee, which pushes you OVER budget.

- Saturday total: $422.38 all-in (Schooner midsize $249 + pet hair $55 + Saturday $25 = $329 taxable + $28.38 tax at 8.625% + $65 East Bay travel, no generator fee because you have outlet). That's $22.38 over your $400 cap.

**Weekday?** Has to be weekday to stay under $400:

- Tue-Fri total: $395.22 all-in (same $249 + $55 = $304 taxable + $26.22 tax + $65 travel). Within your $400 cap, by $4.78.
- Example open weekday: Tue Nov 10 afternoon 1:00-2:30pm is open. Other weekdays open too.

Notes:
- No $30 generator fee because you have a grounded outlet within 75ft. Without it they'd add $30 + tax, or couldn't do it in enclosed garage.
- Your single-seat hair does not trigger the $60 excessive-pet-hair surcharge — that only applies if embedded hair is in 3+ seats or >half cargo floor. Technician confirms on arrival; if they judged it excessive, weekday would also go over budget.

report.answer:
Who fits: Cormorant Mobile Detailing is mobile-only in San Francisco and will come to your lot. Your ask maps to their The Skiff - exterior wash, outside-only:

- Wash / just the outside = The Skiff: foam hand wash, wheels/tires, door jambs, outside glass, hand dry, nothing inside
- Ford Transit (full-size van) = oversized / Class D
- 94103 = in their no-travel-fee San Francisco zone

Catch on Saturday: 3 vans together counts as a fleet job, and fleet jobs run Tuesday to Friday only. So they cannot do all 3 in one visit on a Saturday.

Your options with them:

1) All 3 together on a weekday - Tuesday-Friday - $407.67 all-in
That is: $139 x 3 = $417.00 minus 10% fleet discount for 3-4 vehicles (-$41.70) = $375.30 + 8.625% tax ($32.37) + $0 travel in 94103. $50 deposit counts toward total. About 4.5 hours on site. Next open weekday in their calendar is Tue 11/10 afternoon.

You will need a working spigot within 100 ft for 3+ vehicles - they only carry 65 gallons for up to 2 vehicles. The Skiff needs no power outlet. Vehicles need to be in a driveway / private lot / open garage / legal street space with 3 ft clear on both sides, plus room within 100 ft for their 20-ft work van.

2) Saturday morning is possible, but max 2 vans per day under their rules:
- 1 Transit on Sat morning: $178.15 all-in ($139 + $25 Saturday fee = $164 + $14.15 tax)
- 2 Transits same Saturday morning: $329.13 all-in ($278 + $25 Saturday fee = $303 + $26.13 tax)
Saturday is morning window only 8:00-9:30am arrival, + $25 Saturday fee per visit. Next open Saturdays shown: Nov 7 and Nov 21 morning.

They work Tue-Sat, closed Sun/Mon. Need 24hrs notice. If rain >=50% forecast they move exterior work and you don't lose deposit.

Others checked and ruled out:
- Peninsula Suds: Peninsula only, not serving San Francisco
- Sunset Shine Auto Spa: shop drop-off, not mobile
- Ferry Point Auto Care: partner garages only, not your lot

To book 3 vans you'd need a Tue-Fri fleet slot. If Saturday is firm, you'd have to split - e.g. 2 on one Saturday + 1 on another Saturday - or ask the owner if she'd make an exception for 3 on Saturday (booking goes via request form, she replies by text/email within 4 business hours Mon-Sat 8am-6pm, job booked only when $50 deposit link paid).

No budget was given, so no budget comparison made.

No — Cormorant Mobile Detailing does NOT do ceramic coating, so they can't do a multi-year ceramic coating on your Model Y.

Their own booking-info site says explicitly:

> "Cormorant Mobile Detailing doesn't do ceramic coating, and its longest-lasting paint protection is the 6-month paint sealant."

That also means the old Bay Auto Pages directory listing that says "ceramic coating" is wrong — Cormorant's own site flags that listing as false (last updated March 2023, also wrong on price, boats, and Sundays).

What they DO offer for paint protection:

Your words "ceramic coated / paint's protected" map to their "paint sealant / wax / paint protection" = 6-month paint sealant add-on.

Your Model Y maps to their midsize / Class B (they list Tesla Model Y as midsize).

Options for a Model Y in 94114 (which is in their no-travel-fee San Francisco zone):

1. Closest to "protection for years" — still only 6 months:
**The Flagship (polish-and-seal detail)** — includes full detail + clay bar + one-step machine polish + 6-month sealant + upholstery shampoo
- $629 + 8.625% tax = $683.25 total, $0 travel fee in 94114
- $150 deposit counts toward total, ~6.5 hrs, must start morning window

2. Cheaper protection option:
**Full detail (The Schooner) + clay bar + 6-month sealant**
- $249 + $70 clay + $115 sealant = $434 + $37.43 tax = $471.43 total, $0 travel fee in 94114
- $50 deposit, ~5 hrs

Notes:
- Sealant can only be bought together with clay bar on a Skiff or Schooner; both are already included in Flagship.
- If you want true multi-year ceramic coating, you'll need a different shop — Cormorant doesn't offer it, PPF, multi-stage correction, or engine work either.
- They are mobile-only, come to you in Noe Valley, need a 120V outlet within 75ft for Cutter/Schooner/Flagship or $30 generator fee (can't use generator in enclosed/underground garage).

report.answer:
Straight answer: No — Cormorant will not promise that The Flagship will remove your scratch.

Their own rule for The Flagship says: whether the one-step polish will remove a particular scratch isn't known until a technician inspects it, because it depends on whether the scratch has gone through the clear coat.

That means paying $596.35 total for your Mazda3 in 94131 ( $549 small/Class A + $47.35 tax, no travel fee) does not guarantee the key mark comes out. A fingernail-catching scratch is exactly the kind that needs that in-person inspection.

Two other straight facts before you spend:

- The Flagship's one-step machine polish is their ONLY polish — they don't do multi-stage / two-stage paint correction / compounding.
- If the scratch is still there after, their free redo does NOT cover it — the redo policy explicitly doesn't cover stains or scratches that were already there.

If scratch removal is the whole reason for booking, don't book the Flagship for that reason alone — you'll need a technician to look at the door first to see if it's through the clear coat.

For your exact setup — RAV4 in an underground garage in Mission Bay 94158 with no outlet near your space — Cormorant cannot do the interior cleaning down there, and they will not bring a generator as a workaround.

* What you want = The Cutter - Interior detail: vacuum seats, carpets, mats and trunk, wipe dash/console/door panels, inside glass and spot-clean. Starting at $159.

* Power rule, from Cormorant's own FAQ:
The Cutter, Schooner and Flagship need a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle, or they run a generator for a $30 fee. The generator can't run in an enclosed or underground garage, so without an outlet we can't do those packages in there.

With no usable outlet and an underground/enclosed garage, you don't meet either option. The generator idea is explicitly ruled out for that location.

* Only package that doesn't need power is The Skiff - exterior wash only, starting at $69 — and it doesn't touch the inside, so it doesn't solve your request.

* Building manager / HOA: That's on you. For apartments/condos: You do need to get the building manager's permission before you book, this goes for HOA-managed lots too. We don't contact managers, and if we get refused on the day it counts as a no-show.

What would make it possible:
- A different spot that meets their parking rules — driveway, private lot, open garage or legal street space with 3 ft clear on both sides + room for their work van within 100 ft — AND either an outlet within 75 ft or an open-air location where they can run the generator (+$30).
- Get permission first if it's still an HOA-managed lot.

I did not book anything or share your details.

You booked The Flagship — Cormorant's top package with the one-step machine polish.

Deposit for The Flagship is $150. At about 36 hours before your arrival window you are in the 24-to-48-hour band:

* Cancel now: you get half the deposit back = $75 back, $75 kept.
  Rule: full back 48h+, half back 24-48h, nothing back under 24h.

* Move it instead: you can reschedule once for free because you have more than 24 hours notice and you haven't moved it before. Cost $0.
  You must do it by phone or text only — call/text 415-555-0142. Any later than 24h notice or shorter-notice change counts as a cancellation under the rule above.

Office hours are Monday-Saturday 8am-6pm if you need to reach them now.
